name: MCP Server
description: Lets agents outside the editor (CodeFlow, Claude Code, Codex…) see what is open in AICode — unsaved text included — propose edits you accept or reject, and drive the interface: run any command, read and change settings, move views and open windows. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only, behind a token. Reads a file from disk only when an agent asks for one that is not open.
author: AICode
